base_member_text: [L57-L60] (MED/global-state-initialization) The public module-wide stencil-bound integers have no initialization, so any caller that observes them before the separate setup routine assigns every bound receives undefined state.
audit_member_text: [L57-L60] (MED/uninitialized global ranges) All exported computational range bounds lack initial values, so any use before ranges_init receives undefined indices.

adversarial.rationale: The lifecycle calls ranges_init after decomposition and before nonhydrostatic setup, means/output initialization, and all computation steps. ranges_init assigns every declared bound on all relevant branches, and no earlier active stencil use was found; merely being public and undefined before required setup is not a demonstrated defect.

neutralizer.quote:
call space_distribute_space (sglobal,s,par)
#endif

      call ranges_init(s)

      ! nonh_init does not always need to be called
      if (par%wavemodel==WAVEMODEL_NONH) call nonh_init(s,par)

      ! initialize output
      call means_init             (sglobal,s,par     )

      call output_init            (sglobal,s,par,tpar)

base_member_text: [L42-L49] (HIGH/declaration) Each allocatable index array specifies DIMENSION(:) both as an attribute and again on the entity name, a duplicate shape declaration that conforming compilers can reject.

audit_member_text: [L51-L52] (HIGH/uninitialized cache flags) The collected and precollected flags have no default initialization in the type definition even though collection logic reads collected(index) to decide whether to skip work.
dispositions.rationale: span-refuted: Absence of a type-component initializer is neutralized by explicit runtime initialization: output.F90 L37 sets collected=.false. before collection and L43-L44 copies the resulting flags into precollected on the output master. spaceparams.F90 L1083-L1087 reads collected on that master and broadcasts the decision, so the cited declarations alone do not establish uninitialized cache use.
